rstdp_config.critic: not used; episode return minus running baseline
rstdp_config.action_epsilon_schedule: hold initial epsilon until mean reward over last 20 episodes reaches 22; then decay by 0.9995 per episode, restore initial epsilon if reward falls below threshold
rstdp_config.temperature_schedule: hold current T until mean reward over last 20 episodes reaches 22; then decay

diagnostics.wta_mask_encoding: integer bitmask; bit j denotes output column j
diagnostics.wta_candidate_masks: per decision, union across neural substeps
diagnostics.spike_candidate_masks: all spiking outputs before WTA, per decision and substep
diagnostics.nonwta_spiking_outputs: spiking outputs that lost WTA; count per decision
crossbar_episode_metrics: net and absolute X change by output column
fraction of cells near X=0 or X=1
